name: Push banner
author: Brett
description: A banner listing every branch that isn't on main yet in AmberX-AXF, axHub and Build-Pilot (commits ahead/behind, age, last commit, its open PR and that PR's CI), with Open PR and Merge: every change reaches main only through its PR (one is opened for every branch), brought up to date with main and re-tested before it merges (not behind, CI passed on the pinned head; re-checked on the server). Auto-merge takes ready PRs oldest first, one merge per round, and sets branch protection on main where the token may. Shown above every tab in Patches through the console's banner strip. The console server talks to GitHub with its own token, which never reaches the browser.
